title: Our Journey
subtitle: A book we are writing together, one reflection at a time.

stages.title: Seeing
stages.intro: Before we change anything, we learn to look.
prompts: What did I notice today?
What do I still not know?
What do I want to carry with me?

stages.title: Understanding
stages.intro: Looking again, more slowly, at what we saw.
prompts: What did I come to understand about you?
What did I come to understand about myself?
Where did we misunderstand each other, and what was underneath?

stages.title: The Voices We Carry
stages.intro: The rules and voices we brought with us from before.
prompts: Which voices from my childhood still speak when I decide?
Which rules did I inherit without choosing them?
Which voice do I want to keep, and which can I set down?

stages.title: Desire
prompts: What do I want, if I let myself say it plainly?
What do I want for us?
What am I afraid will happen if I want it out loud?

stages.title: Choosing
stages.intro: Every choice is also a letting go.
prompts: What are we choosing?
What are we choosing not to do?
What will tell us whether it was the right choice?

stages.title: Living Experiment
stages.intro: Trying something small, and paying attention to what happens.
prompts: What did we try?
What happened, honestly?
What will we keep, change, or let go?

stages.title: Growing
stages.intro: Looking back over the whole road.
prompts: Who was I when we began?
What has changed between us?
What do I want to remember from this journey?
